title: EMKAY'S OPTIMIZATIONS
description: EMKAY'S OPTIMIZATIONS is a lightweight Minecraft modpack boosting performance, load times, and smoothness while keeping essential OptiFine features like shaders, zoom, and connected textures, compatible with any world or server.
body:
# **Introducing EMKAY'S OPTIMIZATIONS!**
Experience smooth gameplay, fast loading times, and a performance boost that'll leave your game feeling remarkable! This modpack not only enhances performance but also includes shader support, zoom, and connected textures!
![GO AND PLAY NOW!!!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a61b6bb52dd5e07e28d3d78be96baceb88dde25c.png)


## # **Why EMKAY'S OPTIMIZATIONS?**
The goal of EMKAY'S OPTIMIZATIONS is to create a super easy way for people to increase their performance while providing just the most essential OptiFine features. It cuts back on some of the clutter in other OptiFine replacement packs that I believe most players will not use.

## # **Works Anywhere**
EMKAY'S OPTIMIZATIONS doesn't add any additional content to the game, allowing for compatibility with most any world or server.
![PLAY AND TRULY ENJOY!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/06b6195a27638dbb304c4da9619bee24b8fa48b8.jpeg)
